notes.title: Azurael's Circle: Chapter 5 on Steam + bug fixes!
notes.content:
Azurael's Circle: Chapter 5 has now been released on Steam. You can find it here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1682980/Azuraels_Circle_Chapter_5/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1682980/Azuraels_Circle_Chapter_5/[/url]

Chapters 1, 2, 3 and 4 have also been updated to fix various bugs reported to me throughout the last couple of years. Most of the fixes are minor graphical issues, spelling errors and the occasional bug.

Chapter 1 will forever remains free and Chapters 2-5 can be purchased as part of a bundle or separately. I'd recommend the bundle if you plan to play them all because you save 25% buying it as part of the bundle.

If anybody finds any more bugs, please let me know, and I hope you enjoy the finale to the series!

- Jordan

notes.title: Azurael's Circle: Chapter 4 out NOW! 30% off.
notes.content:
Azurael's Circle: Chapter 4 has just been released on Steam!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1060170/Azuraels_Circle_Chapter_4/]Buy it here![/url]

It's currently 30% off so go buy it now and find out another piece of the Azurael puzzle. Production on Chapter 5, the final chapter, will begin shortly so stay tuned on Twitter for some info and screenshots.

All the best, folks.

- Jordan
